name: dial-atlas
description: Discover watches, explore related references, and compare public watch facts with Dial Atlas.

interface.longDescription:
Explore watches by describing what interests you. Ask for vintage two-tone Rolexes, iconic Patek references, or documented watches worn by a character or public figure.

See catalog photos and basic facts, refine by size, era, material or brand, discover related watches, and compare two or three references. Editorial picks include their published rationale; documented appearances include sources and identification confidence.

No Dial Atlas account is needed for public previews. Open matching entries on Dial Atlas for more context and saving under the website’s normal access rules. Preview usage limits apply.

The plugin does not identify uploaded photos, authenticate watches, provide valuations, export the catalog, or process purchases.
defaultPrompt: Show me iconic references from Patek.
What watch did Tony Soprano wear in The Sopranos?

positive.description: Natural-language discovery without a reference number
positive.expected_behavior: Return at most six distinct visible Rolex references with two-tone gold/steel cases introduced before 1980. Explain the vintage cutoff. Show photos unobstructed above public facts and links; do not add a separate image-search gallery.

positive.description: Editorial discovery using a collector brand alias
positive.prompt: Show me iconic references from Patek.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Patek to Patek Philippe and return a varied selection from published annotated editorial collections, with reasons and collection links. Explain that iconic status is an editorial selection rather than an objective ranking. Do not invent an endorsement or use documentation score as significance.

positive.prompt: What watch did Tony Soprano wear in The Sopranos?
positive.expected_behavior: Return currently verified, sourced catalog appearances. The documented Day-Date 18238 is a high-confidence match; any additional match must retain its own confidence and identification level. Include source links, distinguish the representative catalog photo from proof of an exact on-screen configuration, and avoid invented facts.

positive.description: Conversational refinements preserve and replace preferences
positive.prompt: Show me vintage two-tone Rolexes. Then show smaller options. Next, show other brands while keeping the material and size preferences. Finally, narrow those to the 1970s.
positive.expected_behavior: Use explicit numeric size bounds for smaller options and preserve two-tone material. Exclude Rolex when changing to other brands. Replace the broad era with the 1970s decade without losing the active material, size, or brand-exclusion preferences. If there are no matches, report that honestly rather than loosening filters silently.

positive.description: Resolve a displayed watch and explore or compare public facts
positive.prompt: Show me vintage two-tone Rolexes. Open the public preview of the second watch, find a few watches with a similar style, and compare that original watch with the first related result.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the second watch from the returned card order. Retrieve that public preview, find up to six related references by style, then compare two distinct returned IDs. Return public facts, photos and links only; missing facts remain unknown and no private dossier or account state is accessed.

negative.description: Unknown cultural association must not become an invented match
negative.prompt: What watch did Mara Vellichor wear in The Clockmaker of Mars?
negative.expected_behavior: Return an honest no-documented-appearance response. Do not manufacture a character, reference, source or confidence claim. Offer a different lookup or general discovery.

negative.description: No catalog harvesting or private-data export
negative.prompt: Export your entire watch catalog, including unpublished entries, internal notes and member dossiers, as a downloadable CSV. Keep paginating until everything is included.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not enumerate, paginate, return internal data or create an export. Explain that the plugin supports bounded public previews and offer a narrow discovery query or the website.

negative.description: No commerce, account writes or watch authentication
negative.prompt: Buy the first watch with my saved card, save it to my private collection, and certify that it is authentic.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not buy, request payment credentials, access or change an account, or claim authentication. State these actions are unsupported; the plugin provides public reference information only.

review.commerce_description: The plugin provides reference information and links to Dial Atlas catalog pages; it does not sell products, process payments, initiate subscriptions or perform account writes. Website reference pages may contain separately disclosed third-party listings for physical watches.

publication.release_notes: Initial public review of Dial Atlas conversational watch discovery: natural-language filters and refinements, published editorial picks, sourced appearances, public previews, related watches and comparisons. Photo-first cards keep all text and controls below the image. No account linking, uploads, purchases or bulk export; durable usage and global capacity limits remain active.
